name: print-social-carousel-periwinkle-population-portrait-grid
title: Periwinkle World Population Day carousel with portrait photo grid
whatItIs: A five-tile carousel on a periwinkle background for World Population Day, built around a grid of small black-and-white portrait photos, halftone-dot texture, and bold sans headlines.
whatItMeans: A dense grid of varied individual portraits visually embodies 'population' more directly than any icon could, turning the statistic into a literal collage of real faces.
techniques: assemble a grid of many small individual portrait photos to literalize a 'population' or 'community' concept
apply halftone dot texture over photos to unify varied source images into one visual style
use one flat brand color as the consistent background across every tile for cohesion

vocabulary.definition: an image effect simulating tonal variation through varying dot sizes, referencing print/newspaper reproduction
